profile.name: 通用实验室物理设备
profile.description: 用于表示可连接到计算机的通用实验室硬件设备，通常可通过 USB 标识进行发现，并支持初始化、命令发送、设备匹配和后台状态监测。该证据未指向具体仪器型号，更像是适用于多类实验设备的通用物理设备抽象。
profile.description_en: A generic representation of a computer-connected laboratory hardware device, typically discoverable by USB identifiers and supporting initialization, command transfer, device matching, and background status monitoring. The evidence does not indicate a specific instrument model and instead points to a general physical-device abstraction for multiple kinds of lab equipment.

registry.name: Physical
registry.description: Physical Device是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、初始化、启动、状态查询、设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, any等操作。
